field_contract.units: integer bytes/ns/count; signed paired differences remain signed; IDs/path_hex/status text
field_contract.read_elapsed_ns: public Exec through terminal byte-count output drain; includes shell/pipe/FUSE/Store work
field_contract.digest: second public digest Exec, outside read timer; can hit warmed caches
field_contract.setup_wrapper_vs_host: wrapper includes container/utilities; host setup includes fresh Store/Client/fork/mount proof
field_contract.end_vs_cleanup: host End and wrapper process/container cleanup separate; invocation encloses both
field_contract.cgroup_boundary: cumulative before/after CPU delta includes broad protocol and observer activity, not pure read CPU; observer_ns is wall duration, not subtractable CPU
field_contract.memory: host current and process-lifetime peak separate; container current and lifetime peak separate; never sum peaks
field_contract.io: host I/O phase deltas; container I/O unavailable/null
field_contract.fuse: per-action read/write counts unavailable/null; End session totals encompass mount proof, read, digest and End; not phase attribution
field_contract.disk: separate copy/temp/combined runtime and owned preparation+campaign scopes; no allocation-comparison eligibility
field_contract.native: direct physical work counters, repeated dependencies count; static proof plus fresh setup and aggregate counters corroborate selected population without per-ID trace
field_contract.null: UNRUN/invalid missing observations or explicitly unavailable counters; never zero substitution
field_contract.statistics: exact n3 min/median/max and by-repetition signed differences only after all60 rows validate; no p95/p99, cold-cache, depth-causality or general-tail claim
